LightningComponentBundle.description: Interactive slope chart powered by D3.js, comparing a before/after value per entity with drill-down support.

property.name: groupByField
property.label: Entity Field
property.description: API name of the field identifying each entity (one connecting line per distinct value)

property.name: startValueField
property.label: Start (Before) Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field holding the 'before' value

property.name: endValueField
property.label: End (After) Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field holding the 'after' value

property.name: theme
property.label: Color Theme
property.description: Color theme; drives the increase/decrease line colors

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object to query. When set (and no records are passed in), the chart self-fetches this object's raw records via GraphQL. Also used for drill-down navigation on line click.

property.name: filterField
property.label: Filter Field
property.description: Field to filter by on drill-down (defaults to Entity Field)

property.name: recordLimit
property.label: Record Limit
property.description: Maximum records to fetch on the structured self-fetch path. A free-text GraphQL Query is bounded only by its own first: clause. Leave empty for default (2000).

property.name: graphqlFilter
property.label: GraphQL Filter (JSON)
property.description: Optional filter for the structured self-fetch, as JSON: {"field":"Name","operator":"like","value":"[D3DEMO]%"}. Operators: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, in. Ignored when records are passed in or a GraphQL Query override is set.

property.name: graphqlQuery
property.label: GraphQL Query
property.description: Optional override of the built query. Must be a UI API record query (uiapi.query) whose node selects the Entity Field, Start Value Field, and End Value Field as top-level fields; the returned rows are shaped client-side into one connecting line per row. UI-API-queryable objects only; at most 2,000 records; GraphQL syntax. Footgun: rows missing any of those three fields are dropped silently, so a query that omits one renders fewer lines than expected (or reports no data if every row is dropped). Leave blank to build the query automatically.

propertyType.name: T
propertyType.label: Record Type
propertyType.description: SObject type for the record collection
